name: allterrain-work
description: Projects and tasks on a drag-and-drop board, as an OpenStation desktop app.

scripts.build: npm run build:bundles && npm run deploy
scripts.build:bundles: npm run build:board && npm run build:widget && npm run build:editor && npm run build:explorer
scripts.build:board: ATWORK_TARGET=board vite build --mode development && ATWORK_TARGET=board vite build --mode production
scripts.build:widget: ATWORK_TARGET=widget vite build --mode development && ATWORK_TARGET=widget vite build --mode production
scripts.plugin:build: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:bundles
scripts.build:editor: ATWORK_TARGET=editor vite build --mode development && ATWORK_TARGET=editor vite build --mode production
scripts.build:explorer: ATWORK_TARGET=explorer vite build --mode development && ATWORK_TARGET=explorer vite build --mode production
scripts.plugin:release: npm run plugin:build && npm run plugin:check && node bin/package.mjs
